tei:div.tei:p: dpal phag mo gru pa'i dpon rabs byon tshul bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa ti/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i dpon rab ni/ dang po spyan snga chos rje'i dus na/ 'bri khung nas sgom pa shāka rin gyi spyi'i kha ta byed/ spyan snga ba'i nye gnas sgom mtshon gyi/ rkang yangs dang smad hor la ngo lta byas/ rting la mdo khams nas/ dpon rdo rje dpal bya ba'i mi gzhon gcig byung*/ rus pa lha bzis yin byas pas spyan snga ba'i drung du bzhag sngon la gsol ja ba bcol/ rting du rgya yul la brdzangs pas/ phag khru khri skor du stag mgo blang*/ khri dpon yun ring du byas| shing pho stag lo la sne gdong rdzong brtsigs/ de 'das nas/ de'i nu bo gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi dpon byas/ de 'das rting khong gi dpon skya yar 'brog pa/ byang gzhon gyis khri dpon byas/ skabs der sa 'bri 'khrug pa la/ byang gzhon gyis/ sa skya pa gang gsungs byas/ dpon chen ag lan gyis/ phag gru babasreg par byung ba la/ byang gzhon gyi zhus pas 'a'atshangakla'atsheng blu/ byang gzhon shi nas/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi tsha bo/ gzhon nu yon tan gyi khri dpon byas| hor rgyal bu thi mur sbo kha yum sras bod du bzhugs pa'i zhabs tog dang*/ dmag gi phyag phyi cung ma 'grub/ phyi go ma chod kyang*/ nang du zhing pa ya gsum la sogs pa la gzan po byas pas/ rin po che gcung rgya bo ma mnyes par/ rgyal po yum sras la zhus pas/ gzhon nu yon tan phab/ gong du zhu ba btang*/ de ma 'khor bar la rgyal po'i ma ma go cha/ sa skya ba'i chos khrims pa rin chen bkra shis| rin po che'i nye gnas brtson 'grus dpal/ gzhon nu yon tan gyi dpon 'og ma/ grags pa 'od zer/ sngags hu la hu'i bskos pa'i yul bsrung pa/ go bo chu'i bu rdo rje/ yar lung jo bo brag rin rnams 'dzoms kyin/ khri skor gyi bya ba bsgrubs| de mtshams gong du bla ma ti shri grags 'od pa'i bdag mdzad nas/ rin po che'i gcung rgyal po la khri dpon gyi 'ja' sa bsgrubs nas/

bla dpon sbrag sa | gzhon nu yon tan la bstan sor/ 'phyongs rgyas smon 'khar byin/ gcung rgya bo grongs rting*/ rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i gcen po/ rgyal mtshan dpal gyis gong du byon/ lha rje phag mo gru pa'i zhus nas/ lung gis rgyal mtshan dpal bskos/ de'i lag nas khong rang gi nu bo/ grags bzang sa skya bas zhus nas bskaus de'i lag nas/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi bu rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi 'ja' sa blangs/ rin po che grags rgyal ba'i gcung po/ byang chub rgyal mtshan/ shing pho stag lo la bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i drung du/ lo bcu bzhi lon pa yos lo la phyin nas/ phyag phyir bsdad dam gnyer byas/ bla ma'i gsungs nas/ khyod rin po che byed dam/ khri dpon byed gsungs nas/ rin po che byed lags zhus pas| de mi yong bar 'dug khri dpon byed dgos pas/ g.yul rgyal dang*/ legs bshad la ltos gsungs thugs mkhyen mnga' bar 'dug der rjes bdag chen pos sprad nas/ bla ma mnyam med pa la slob gnyer zhus/ brtag gnyis bslab 'brug lo ston gzhug la/ khong gi bshad gsar gyi ja dang*/ gcen po slob dpaun grags pa bzang po/ phag gru'i khri dpon la/ sa skya nas 'khyon bskos byas pa'i/ tshogs ja mnyam du bkol/ ti shri kun blo'i gong du byon dus/ rgyal mtshan skyabs phab nas/ khong gi khri dpon du bskos/ gtsang dbang rgyal po'i 'ja' sa dang*/ sī tu'i ming thob/ rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi tsha bo bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis lung gi bcad cing*/ khyon gyi bsko bzhag dang*/ mtho sman gang du byung kyang*/ sus kyang ma thub par/ rgyal khams dbang du bsdus pa'i mi de 'di yin no/ /ti sī du byang chub rgyal mtshan pa 'di nyid sku na gzhon dus/ phyi nang gi bde bzar dka' dgu sbyongs brjod che na'ang*/ dgung lo nga lnga pa'i thog chu pho spre lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po lha rtser sgor/

de 'don phyir khri skor rnams kyi dmag bsdus pa'i dpon thob nas/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin/ sa skyar bca' ho btang khrims bcas pa nas/ bstan pa'i btsugs te/ mtshan byus dang mnga' thang yar 'phel du byung*/ khong gi ring la/ rang re lha gzigs kyi rgyud pa 'dis/ mi'i mi go chod cing*/ chos kyi chos go chod pa gcig dgos pa 'dug gsungs/ rtsed thang gi dgon pa gsar du btab/ bshad grwa btsugs/ sne gdong dang srol gcig par byas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nam rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba gdan drangs/ chos sde'i rab gnas dang khong rang gi dbon po/ slob dpon shākya rgyal mtshan chos dpon la bskos pa'i tshogs dpon zhus/ chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba la'ang*/ mkhyen rab dang rtsol shin du chai bar grags cing*/ phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyi bya ba la byas pa/ phyag rjes dpon rab sngon rting*/ du gzhan las kyang 'di nyid mchog tu che bar byed do/ /tī sī tu de dgung lo re gsum pa/ me pho 'brug gi lo la bde bar gshegs so/ /de nas dbon po slob dpon shākya rgyal mtshan pas/ sne gdong khri thog tu bzhugs/ bla dpon sbrags nas mdzad pa'i rigs la/ rgyal khrims 'jags shing*/ chos khrims dar dbus gtsang bde ba dang*/ mnga' zhabs skyid par byung na dgongs pa'i thugs dge ba kho na bzung pas/ kun gyi 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan zhes bstod cing bsngags pa'i snyan grags cher byung shing*| tshul de dang mthun par gyur to/ /hor tho gan the mur rgyal pos kyang*/ chang gu'i gung gi mtshan dang*/ las kha gnang*/ khong gshegs rting gcung po khri dpon shākya rin chen pa/ sne gdong du bskaus nas/ dbus gtsang gis gzhis bskor la 'byon par byas/ gzhung skyid mo gshong du phebs nub/ khang skor byin la me stobs chen shor/ dpon g.yog rnams nyen can la gtad pas/ rtogs bcas kyi phyir log nas/ 'khar thog dgon gsar du bzhugs su bcugathugs ma bde nas mu med mang rab mdzad pas/

khrims bdag snyon par grags pa'ang byung la/ spyan mnga' grags byang pas lo shas bla dpon sbrags nas bzung*/ der rting de'i gcung po grags pa rin chen pa sne gdong du lo 'ga' bskos/ de mtshams dzong byi rgyal mtshan bzang po ba khu dbon gyi/ dam byas nas/ bdag po grags rin pa/ glo bur du gong dkar nas gzhung ko la gdan drangs/ spyan mnga' grags pa'i bden sar bskyal/ sne gdong khri thog tu/ khri dpon shāka rin gyi sras che ba/ grags pa rgyal mtshan pa dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa'i dus/ shing pho byi ba'i lo la/ dpon sar bton/ sku tshe'i stod la/ dbon zhang gi 'khon rtsod dang*/ e snyal gyi sde gzar la sogs/ dka' dgu mang po byung na'ang*/ rting la sde pa nang 'jags/ dbus gtsang gi khri stong phal che ba/ srid dbang du 'dus/ rgya nag ta ming rgyal pos/ kon ting gu shri dang*/ tshe bo dbang gi mtshan/ da ma kha lung lag rtags bzang pa'i rim pa gnang*/ stobs dang dpal 'byor mnga' thang phun sum tshogs pa byung shing*/ dgung lo bcu gcig nas/ lnga cu rtsa dgu'i bar la| mtshan go sa mthon por bzhugs nas/ sde srid yar 'phel du byung pas/ phag mo grub pa'i dpon rgyud/ khri thog tu bzhugs pa la/ 'di pa yun ring cing*/ sku bsod che bar grags/ lnga cu nga dgu bzhes pa/ chu pho byi ba'i lo la sne gdong rtser sku gshegs so/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //lha sa'i byon tshul 'di bris pas/ /lha dang srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi sa | | 'gro la phan bde stsol ba'i 'phri na las 'dzod/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/phag gru'i dpon rabs/ -PAGE 282--PAGE 281-
